memories.text: For login timeout, preserve the original exception type.
For backup restore, restore into a fresh namespace.
For schema rollout, deploy readers before writers.
For worker retry, use the existing retry budget.
For scope routing, keep the caller's original scope.
For release build, use the pinned release toolchain.
